excerpt:
Shall Hall County School District 0126
(Doniphan-Trumbull Public Schools) in the State
of Nebraska issue its bonds in a total principal
amount not to exceed $17,500,000 for the
purposes of financing the costs of (a) making
certain renovations and constructing one or
more additions to the District's existing school
building and related site improvements, and (b)
purchasing certain equipment, furniture and
apparatus for such school building and
additions; said bonds to be issued from time to
time, to be sold at such prices, to bear interest
at such rates, to become due at such times, and
to have such other terms and provisions, all as
may be fixed and determined by the Board of
Education of the District; and

"Shall the District cause to be levied and
collected annually a special levy of taxes
against all the taxable property in the District
sufficient in rate and amount to pay the principal
of, the premium, if any, and the interest on said
bonds as the same become due?
